label: Modal entailment versus independently adequate existence explanation
term: modal entailment versus independently adequate existence explanation
resolution: NecessitatesExistenceAt constrains truth across accessible worlds; copied satisfies it by repeating the target condition. That repetition establishes no direction, relevance, real nature or reason why the target obtains. Intrinsic explanation is not efficient self-production and is not rejected merely for lacking an external cause. A principled intrinsic account must independently characterize this actual nature and its explanatory role; its positive adequacy is open. No common token for all individual existence facts is distinct from no explanation of a totality: the existing signature does not add such a fact or a compositional aggregation rule. Modeled relation roots are not absolutely unexplained facts or divine beings.
